err.control_off: An admin hasn't switched this Mission control on.
err.control_value: That value is outside what an admin allows for this Mission control.
err.control_wait: This Mission control was changed a moment ago. Try again in a few minutes.
err.control_not_set: This Mission control already uses the config value.
err.control_config: A Mission control here is unknown, or has a minimum above its maximum.
err.setting_grant_department: Each Mission controls grant needs a department key of Config.Departments (such as sast).
err.setting_grant_grant: Each Mission controls grant needs either minGrade (that grade and up) or grades (only those), not both.
mc.control_desc.cooldownScale: Multiplies every mission's cooldown, one number per mission type, for the whole server (0 = no cooldown).
mc.control_desc.abandonCooldown: Seconds an officer waits after abandoning a run or going down on one, for the whole server (0 = none).
mc.control_desc.noRepeat: Off lets the same mission come up twice in a row, for the whole server.
mc.control_desc.hourlyCap: Completed missions per officer per hour, for the whole server.
mc.control_desc.dailyCap: Completed missions per officer per day, for the whole server (0 = no cap).
sup.controls.subtitle: Change the rules an admin opened to supervisors. Every change needs a reason and is in the audit log.
sup.controls.self_note: Your own runs keep config values while you relax a rule (and so does any unit you are in).
sup.controls.empty_text: An admin switches them on in Admin UI -> Permissions -> Mission controls.
sup.controls.server_wide_note: This control is server-wide: the change applies to every department.
sup.controls.reset_done: {control} is back to the config value
err.happy_hour_running: A happy hour is already running.
err.happy_hour_used: Today's happy hour has been used. Try again tomorrow.
mc.control_desc.happyHour: For the minutes picked no mission has a cooldown for anyone on the server; the no-repeat rule can go off too. The abandon cooldown and the caps stay. Once a day for supervisors.
hh.banner: Happy hour: no mission cooldowns for
hh.banner_norepeat: The no-repeat rule is off too.
hh.banner_self: It does not apply to you or a unit you are in: you started it.
sup.hh.norepeat: Also switch the no-repeat rule off
sup.hh.used_up: Today's happy hour has been used.
sup.hh.confirm_text: No mission cooldowns for anyone on the server until it ends. You keep your own cooldowns.
sup.hh.confirm_end_text: Mission cooldowns count again at once for everyone.
err.sup_clear_used: You have used all your cooldown clears for today.
err.sup_time_used: You have added time to missions as often as you may today.
mc.control_desc.clearCooldown: Supervisors clear one mission or mission type cooldown of an officer of any department from Department Report. Each officer still has at most the admin's daily clears, by all staff together.
mc.control.addRunTime: Add time to a live mission
mc.control_desc.addRunTime: Supervisors add minutes (min to max per click) to a running mission of their own department from Live Missions. The fast-finish bonus is still judged on the original time limit.
admin.perms.mc.time_total: At most {minutes} min per mission in all (Settings)
sup.notice.cooldowns_cleared: A supervisor cleared one of your mission cooldowns.
sup.notice.time_added: A supervisor added {minutes} minutes to your mission timer.
sup.cd.title: {name} · cooldowns
sup.cd.text: Clear one mission or mission type cooldown. The officer is told and it is in the audit log.
sup.cd.on_run: On a mission now: cooldowns can be cleared after it ends.
sup.cd.officer_used: This officer: {used} of {max} clears used today (all staff)
sup.live.add_time_text: Adds minutes to the mission timer. The fast-finish bonus is still judged on the original time limit.
sup.live.add_time_left: Up to {left} more minutes may be added to this mission; you have {n} additions left today.
mc.control_desc.startTimeout: Seconds a unit of your department has after accepting to reach the start. Set when the run is accepted, so a change never moves a run already going.
mc.control_desc.readyCheck: Seconds a unit led by your department has to answer the ready check. Off skips the ready check, only while an admin allows it.
mc.control_desc.timeLimit: Multiplies the mission's time limit for runs of your department. The fast-finish bonus still uses the unscaled limit.
mc.control_desc.idleCheck: Seconds after a run of your department starts before officers who never reached the start are removed (with the usual idle result). Only stricter than the config.
admin.perms.mc.flag.canTurnOff: Supervisors may switch the ready check off
mc.control_desc.difficulty: How hard mission NPCs are on runs your department leads: one of the presets an admin lists. Set when the run is accepted. Points and cash never change.
mc.control_desc.unitSize: The most officers a unit led by your department may have (invites, joins and accepting a mission). Never above the server's largest unit.
err.type_off_department: Command switched this mission type off for a department in your unit.
err.control_types_all_off: At least one mission type must stay on.
mc.control_desc.types: Switch mission types, or single missions, off for your department. Officers see the type locked; officers of other departments still take it. It stays until you switch it back on.
mc.control_desc.featuredType: One mission type your department's officers see as "Recommended by command", right after their favourites. Points and pay stay the same.
mc.control_desc.missionBan: Supervisors bar one officer of their own department (a lower grade, never themselves) from taking missions for min to max hours, with a reason, from Department Report. The tablet stays usable and a mission already running goes on. The one who set it and admins may lift it early.
err.mission_banned: You have a mission ban: no missions, mission calls or Cross-Department joins until it ends (the Mission Board shows when).
err.member_mission_banned: An officer in your unit has a mission ban: the unit cannot take missions until it ends.
err.mission_ban_hours: Pick a number of hours inside the limits.
err.mission_ban_offline: The officer must be online for a mission ban.
err.mission_ban_grade: You can only ban an officer of a lower grade than yours.
err.mission_ban_used: You have set all your mission bans for today.
err.mission_ban_none: This officer has no mission ban.
err.mission_ban_not_yours: Only the supervisor who set this ban, or an admin, can lift it.
sup.notice.mission_banned: {name} gave you a mission ban for {hours} h. The tablet works as usual; the Mission Board shows when it ends.
sup.ban.title: {name} · mission ban
sup.ban.text: No Mission Board accepts, mission call claims or Cross-Department joins until it ends. The officer is told and it is in the audit log.
sup.ban.mine_used: You: {used} of {n} mission bans set today
sup.ban.not_yours: Only the supervisor who set this ban, or an admin, can lift it.
mc.control_desc.callLane: Your department's own mission calls next to the server's: how often, how many open at once, the areas and the mission types. Only your department's officers see and claim them; you never claim one yourself.
mc.control_desc.staffCallWait: Seconds a supervisor of your department waits between two mission calls he creates. If you shorten it, your own wait stays the config value.
sup.lane.types: Mission types and how often (0 = never)
mc.control_desc.notices: Post a short notice for your own department: its officers see it on Home under Announcements, other departments never do. At most 5 run at once, the banned-word list applies and every post and end is in the audit log.
mc.control_desc.crossDept: Whether your department's officers may join Cross-Department Missions, and how many places they may take in one (0 = no cap). Every board still shows only the running operation, and the wait between launches stays server-wide.
sup.cross.join_off: Officers stay out of Cross-Department Missions
sup.cross.places: Places in one operation (0 = no cap)
sup.notices.title: {dept} notices
sup.notices.full: {n} notices are running already. End one first.
err.notice_per_day: You have posted all your department notices for today.
err.dept_notice_too_many: Your department has the most notices running already. End one first.
err.dept_notice_unknown: That notice is not a running notice of your department.
mc.control_desc.boards: Whether other departments see your officers by name or by callsign only, and which Rank by tabs your officers see on the Leaderboard. Counts, the Department Challenge and the admin boards never change.
mc.control_desc.reviewRules: Stricter review of your department's flagged runs: a Void needs a second supervisor of the department, and flags of the kinds you pick go to admins only. Admins are never bound by it.
sup.boards.show_on: Other departments see your officers' names
sup.boards.show_off: Other departments see your officers' callsigns only
sup.boards.metrics: Rank by tabs your officers see (Points always)
sup.rules.second_on: A Void needs a second supervisor of the department
err.void_second_needed: You voided this run already. A second supervisor of the department must confirm it.
err.void_second_dept: Only a supervisor of the run's department may confirm this Void.
admin.action.voidPending: Void waiting for a second supervisor
mc.control_desc.twists: Which twists your department's leaders are offered when they take a mission, and which of them start ticked. A twist your department does not offer is refused. The twists' bonuses never change.
sup.twists.ticked: Ticked when the accept step opens
sup.twists.none: No twist is enabled on this server.
err.twist_department: Your department does not offer that twist. Choose again.
mc.control_desc.happyHourCash: Multiplies the cash of completed runs your department leads that were accepted while a happy hour ran. The bonus stays for the run when the hour ends. Never on test runs, Cross-Department runs or the Weekly Boss; points never change.
mc.control_desc.twistCash: Multiplies each twist's cash bonus on runs your department leads. All chosen twists together still stop at the server's twist cash cap; points never change.
mc.control_desc.typeOfTheDay: Pick one mission type for tomorrow. Tomorrow your department's officers earn the Type of the Day points on it instead of the server's type; other departments keep the server's. One pick a day, and never on your own runs or a unit you are in.
err.tod_picked_today: Your department already picked a Type of the Day today. Pick again after the daily reset.
sup.tod.today: Counts today for your department: {type}. A pick now counts on {day}.
